title: Bengali Class 1: First words and useful phrases
topic: Class 01 · First words and useful phrases
summary: A complete beginner lesson with 421 categorized vocabulary entries and 200 useful phrases, sentences, questions, instructions, and patterns.
focus: Everyday vocabulary, short sentences, questions, instructions, opposites, and foundational sentence patterns

phrases.en: I do not know the answer.
I do not need any more.
The book is on the table.
The ball is under the table.
The cat is inside the room.
The school is near the house.
The tree is in front of the house.
There is a little water here.
A bird flies in the sky.
I go to school in the morning.

practice.prompt: Choose one vocabulary category. Read each Bengali word aloud, then recall its English meaning.
practice.answer: Use Word Loop and the audio controls to repeat words you miss.

practice.prompt: Practice one আমি, সে, এটি, আমার, কোথায়, কী, or কে pattern and replace one word to make a new sentence.
practice.answer: Keep the pattern unchanged and choose a word from the vocabulary list.

practice.prompt: Choose five useful phrases and say them in a short conversation with a partner.
practice.answer: Listen to each Bengali sentence before repeating it.

notes: Work through one category at a time; this lesson is designed as a complete Class 1 reference, not a single sitting.
Repeated words and phrases are intentionally retained when they teach a second category or sentence pattern.
Use Games for recognition practice and Word Loop for listening and repetition.
